title: The Orchard of the Lower Danube
author: Jude Villalobos
blurb: Ines Amberdale, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
